# Plot from raw data
```{r}
clean_file <- "Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv"
out_A <- "Figure/corr_raw.png"
out_B <- "Figure/hcluster_raw.png"

clean <- read.csv(clean_file, check.names = FALSE)
ord <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi",
         "OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
lab <- c(TLetter = "Letter", TGabor = "Gabor", TPi = "Pi",
         SLetter = "Letter", SGabor = "Gabor", SPi = "Pi",
         OSpan = "OSPAN", CSpan = "CSPAN", Corsi = "SSPAN", Matrix = "UCMRT")
grp <- c(TLetter = "B", TGabor = "B", TPi = "B",
         SLetter = "S", SGabor = "S", SPi = "S",
         OSpan = "C", CSpan = "C", Corsi = "C", Matrix = "C")
grp_pch  <- c(B = 15, S = 17, C = 16)            # square, triangle, circle
grp_name <- c(B = "Backward masking", S = "Spatial masking", C = "Cognitive task")

R <- cor(clean[, ord], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")   # excluded scores are NA
Z <- scale(clean[, ord])                          # z-score each task
n <- length(ord)

## ---- Colours -------------------------------------------------------------
INK   <- "#1f1f1d"
MUTED <- "#6b6a63"
HIST  <- "#4a4a46"
PANEL <- "#f7f7f5"
pal   <- colorRampPalette(c("#c43a39", "#e34948", "#f0efec",
                            "#86b6ef", "#2a78d6", "#184f95"))(256)
lim   <- 0.6                                      # colour scale runs from -lim to +lim
r2col <- function(r) pal[round((pmin(pmax(r, -lim), lim) + lim) / (2 * lim) * 255) + 1]
txtcol <- function(fill) {
  rgb <- col2rgb(fill) / 255
  if (sum(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) * rgb) < 0.45) "white" else INK
}
fmt_r <- function(r) sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf("%.2f", r))
W <- 8.4; H <- 7.2                                # inches
ix <- function(inch) inch / W                     # inches -> figure fraction (x)
iy <- function(inch) inch / H                     # inches -> figure fraction (y)

png(out_A, width = W, height = H, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()

y0 <- 0.15; mat_h <- 0.80                         # bottom and height of the matrix
cell_h <- mat_h / n
cell_w <- cell_h * H / W                          # keep cells square
x0 <- ix(1.05)                                    # left edge of the matrix
gap <- 0.0025

cell_fig <- function(i, j) {                      # i = row (top = 1), j = column
  c(x0 + (j - 1) * cell_w + gap * H / W, x0 + j * cell_w - gap * H / W,
    y0 + mat_h - i * cell_h + gap, y0 + mat_h - (i - 1) * cell_h - gap)
}

breaks <- seq(-4.5, 4.5, by = 0.5)
for (i in seq_len(n)) for (j in seq_len(n)) {
  par(fig = cell_fig(i, j), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  a <- ord[i]; b <- ord[j]
  if (i == j) {                                   # diagonal: histogram
    hist(pmin(pmax(Z[, a], -4.5), 4.5), breaks = breaks, col = HIST, border = "white",
         main = "", xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
    abline(h = 0, col = MUTED, lwd = 0.6)
  } else if (i > j) {                             # lower triangle: correlation
    plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, 1), c(0, 1), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
    fill <- r2col(R[a, b])
    rect(0, 0, 1, 1, col = fill, border = NA)
    text(0.5, 0.5, fmt_r(R[a, b]), col = txtcol(fill), cex = 0.8)
  } else {                                        # upper triangle: scatter
    plot.new(); plot.window(c(-4.2, 4.2), c(-4.2, 4.2), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
    rect(-4.2, -4.2, 4.2, 4.2, col = PANEL, border = NA)
    points(Z[, b], Z[, a], pch = 16, cex = 0.3, col = adjustcolor(MUTED, 0.7))
  }
}

## labels, separators, brackets, colour bar
par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, 1), c(0, 1), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
x_mid <- x0 + (seq_len(n) - 0.5) * cell_w
y_mid <- y0 + mat_h - (seq_len(n) - 0.5) * cell_h
x_end <- x0 + n * cell_w

text(x_mid, y0 - iy(0.13), lab[ord], cex = 0.75, col = INK)            # column labels
text(x0 - ix(0.09), y_mid, lab[ord], adj = 1, cex = 0.75, col = INK)   # row labels

for (k in c(3, 6)) {                                                    # group separators
  segments(x0 + k * cell_w, y0, x0 + k * cell_w, y0 + mat_h, col = INK, lwd = 0.9)
  segments(x0, y0 + mat_h - k * cell_h, x_end, y0 + mat_h - k * cell_h, col = INK, lwd = 0.9)
}

blocks <- list(list(1, 3, "Backward masking"),
               list(4, 6, "Spatial masking"),
               list(7, 10, "Cognitive tasks"))
for (bk in blocks) {
  j1 <- bk[[1]]; j2 <- bk[[2]]
  xa <- x0 + (j1 - 1) * cell_w + ix(0.04); xb <- x0 + j2 * cell_w - ix(0.04)   # bottom bracket
  yb <- y0 - iy(0.40)
  segments(xa, yb, xb, yb, lwd = 3, lend = 1, col = INK)
  text((xa + xb) / 2, yb - iy(0.18), bk[[3]], cex = 0.85, col = INK)
  ya <- y0 + mat_h - (j1 - 1) * cell_h - iy(0.04); yz <- y0 + mat_h - j2 * cell_h + iy(0.04)
  xl <- x0 - ix(0.68)                                                          # left bracket
  segments(xl, ya, xl, yz, lwd = 3, lend = 1, col = INK)
  text(xl - ix(0.12), (ya + yz) / 2, bk[[3]], srt = 90, cex = 0.85, col = INK)
}

cb_x <- x_end + ix(0.12); cb_w <- ix(0.09)                                     # colour bar
cb_y <- seq(y0, y0 + mat_h, length.out = length(pal) + 1)
rect(cb_x, head(cb_y, -1), cb_x + cb_w, tail(cb_y, -1), col = pal, border = NA)
ticks <- c(-0.6, -0.3, 0, 0.3, 0.6)
ty <- y0 + (ticks + lim) / (2 * lim) * mat_h
segments(cb_x + cb_w, ty, cb_x + cb_w + ix(0.04), ty, col = MUTED)
text(cb_x + cb_w + ix(0.07), ty, sprintf("%.1f", ticks), adj = 0, cex = 0.7, col = INK)
text(cb_x + cb_w + ix(0.45), y0 + mat_h / 2, "Correlation", srt = 90, cex = 0.8, col = INK)
dev.off()


hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - R), method = "average")
leaves <- ord[hc$order]
y_lo <- floor((min(hc$height) - 0.05) * 10) / 10   # axis range follows the data

png(out_B, width = 8, height = 3.2, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(3.2, 4.5, 1, 1), xpd = FALSE, yaxs = "i")
plot(as.dendrogram(hc), leaflab = "none", ylim = c(y_lo, max(hc$height) + 0.06),
     yaxt = "n", edgePar = list(col = INK, lwd = 1.4))
axis(2, at = seq(y_lo, max(hc$height) + 0.06, by = 0.10), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.75,
     col = MUTED, col.axis = INK, tcl = -0.3)
mtext("Distance", side = 2, line = 3, cex = 0.85)
par(xpd = NA)
points(seq_len(n), rep(y_lo, n), pch = grp_pch[grp[leaves]], cex = 1.3, col = INK)
text(seq_len(n), y_lo - 0.045, lab[leaves], cex = 0.8, col = INK)
legend("topleft", legend = grp_name, pch = grp_pch, col = INK, bty = "n",
       cex = 0.8, pt.cex = 1.1, inset = c(0.01, 0))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
all_scores <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_scores.csv", check.names = FALSE)
out_file   <- "Figure/leverage.png"
perc_tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
lab <- c(TLetter = "Backward Letter", TGabor = "Backward Gabor", TPi = "Backward Pi",
         SLetter = "Spatial Letter",  SGabor = "Spatial Gabor",  SPi = "Spatial Pi")

# log thresholds, z-scored within task (same scale as the SD screen)
Z <- all_scores
Z[perc_tasks] <- lapply(log(all_scores[perc_tasks]), function(x) as.numeric(scale(x)))

outlier_id <- 21
panels <- list(A = c("TLetter", "SGabor"),   # outlier on one task only: little leverage
               B = c("TGabor",  "SGabor"))   # outlier on both tasks: high leverage

png(out_file, width = 8, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2, 1), mgp = c(2.6, 0.7, 0))
for (p in names(panels)) {
  x <- Z[[panels[[p]][1]]]; y <- Z[[panels[[p]][2]]]
  out   <- Z$id == outlier_id
  r_all <- cor(x, y); r_wo <- cor(x[!out], y[!out])

  plot(x, y, type = "n", xlim = c(-3, 7.5), ylim = c(-3, 7.5), las = 1,
       xlab = paste(lab[panels[[p]][1]]), ylab = paste(lab[panels[[p]][2]]))
  abline(lm(y ~ x), col = "#c43a39", lwd = 1.6)                          # with the outlier
  abline(lm(y[!out] ~ x[!out]), col = "grey40", lwd = 1.6, lty = 2)     # without the outlier
  points(x[!out], y[!out], pch = 16, cex = 0.8, col = adjustcolor("grey30", 0.7))
  points(x[out],  y[out],  pch = 16, cex = 1.4, col = "#c43a39")
  legend("bottomright", bty = "n", cex = 0.8,
         legend = c(sprintf("With outlier: r = %.2f", r_all), sprintf("Without: r = %.2f", r_wo)),
         col = c("#c43a39", "grey40"), lty = c(1, 2), lwd = 1.6)
  mtext(p, side = 3, line = 0.5, adj = 0, font = 2, cex = 1.1)
}
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Plot summary scores (A) and model estimates (B)
out_corr <- "Figure/corr.png"
out_hc   <- "Figure/hcluster.png"

ord <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi",
         "OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
lab <- c(TLetter = "Letter", TGabor = "Gabor", TPi = "Pi",
         SLetter = "Letter", SGabor = "Gabor", SPi = "Pi",
         OSpan = "OSPAN", CSpan = "CSPAN", Corsi = "SSPAN", Matrix = "UCMRT")
grp <- c(TLetter = "B", TGabor = "B", TPi = "B",
         SLetter = "S", SGabor = "S", SPi = "S",
         OSpan = "C", CSpan = "C", Corsi = "C", Matrix = "C")
grp_pch  <- c(B = 15, S = 17, C = 16)            # square, triangle, circle
grp_name <- c(B = "Backward masking", S = "Spatial masking", C = "Cognitive task")
n <- length(ord)

## ---- Data ------------------------------------------------------------------
# A: summary scores
clean <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv", check.names = FALSE)
R_sum <- cor(clean[, ord], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")   # excluded scores are NA
Z_sum <- scale(clean[, ord])

# B: model estimates (SEM)
R_sem <- as.matrix(read.csv("Data/summary/sem_corr_mean.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))[ord, ord]
theta <- read.csv("Data/summary/sem_theta.csv", check.names = FALSE)
theta <- merge(theta, clean[, c("id", "OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")], by = "id")
Z_sem <- scale(theta[, ord])

## ---- Colours -------------------------------------------------------------
INK   <- "#1f1f1d"
MUTED <- "#6b6a63"
HIST  <- "#4a4a46"
PANEL <- "#f7f7f5"
pal   <- colorRampPalette(c("#c43a39", "#e34948", "#f0efec",
                            "#86b6ef", "#2a78d6", "#184f95"))(256)
lim   <- 0.6                                      # colour scale runs from -lim to +lim
r2col <- function(r) pal[round((pmin(pmax(r, -lim), lim) + lim) / (2 * lim) * 255) + 1]
txtcol <- function(fill) {
  rgb <- col2rgb(fill) / 255
  if (sum(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) * rgb) < 0.45) "white" else INK
}
fmt_r <- function(r) sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf("%.2f", r))

## ---- Figure 1: correlation matrices, A above B ----------------------------
W <- 8.4; H <- 7.2                                # inches per panel
Ht <- 2 * H                                       # total height

draw_corr <- function(R, Z, pb, tag) {            # pb = panel bottom (inches)
  y0 <- pb + 0.15 * H; mat_h <- 0.80 * H          # matrix bottom and height (inches)
  cs <- mat_h / n                                 # cell size (inches, square)
  x0 <- 1.05; gap <- 0.018
  breaks <- seq(-4.5, 4.5, by = 0.5)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) for (j in seq_len(n)) {
    par(fig = c(x0 + (j - 1) * cs + gap, x0 + j * cs - gap,
                y0 + mat_h - i * cs + gap, y0 + mat_h - (i - 1) * cs - gap) / c(W, W, Ht, Ht),
        new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
    a <- ord[i]; b <- ord[j]
    if (i == j) {                                 # diagonal: histogram
      hist(pmin(pmax(Z[, a], -4.5), 4.5), breaks = breaks, col = HIST, border = "white",
           main = "", xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
      abline(h = 0, col = MUTED, lwd = 0.6)
    } else if (i > j) {                           # lower triangle: correlation
      plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, 1), c(0, 1), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
      fill <- r2col(R[a, b])
      rect(0, 0, 1, 1, col = fill, border = NA)
      text(0.5, 0.5, fmt_r(R[a, b]), col = txtcol(fill), cex = 0.8)
    } else {                                      # upper triangle: scatter
      plot.new(); plot.window(c(-4.2, 4.2), c(-4.2, 4.2), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
      rect(-4.2, -4.2, 4.2, 4.2, col = PANEL, border = NA)
      points(Z[, b], Z[, a], pch = 16, cex = 0.3, col = adjustcolor(MUTED, 0.7))
    }
  }

  # overlay in inch coordinates: labels, separators, brackets, colour bar, tag
  par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, W), c(0, Ht), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
  x_mid <- x0 + (seq_len(n) - 0.5) * cs
  y_mid <- y0 + mat_h - (seq_len(n) - 0.5) * cs
  x_end <- x0 + n * cs
  text(x_mid, y0 - 0.13, lab[ord], cex = 0.75, col = INK)
  text(x0 - 0.09, y_mid, lab[ord], adj = 1, cex = 0.75, col = INK)
  for (k in c(3, 6)) {
    segments(x0 + k * cs, y0, x0 + k * cs, y0 + mat_h, col = INK, lwd = 0.9)
    segments(x0, y0 + mat_h - k * cs, x_end, y0 + mat_h - k * cs, col = INK, lwd = 0.9)
  }
  blocks <- list(list(1, 3, "Backward masking"), list(4, 6, "Spatial masking"),
                 list(7, 10, "Cognitive tasks"))
  for (bk in blocks) {
    j1 <- bk[[1]]; j2 <- bk[[2]]
    xa <- x0 + (j1 - 1) * cs + 0.04; xb <- x0 + j2 * cs - 0.04; yb <- y0 - 0.40
    segments(xa, yb, xb, yb, lwd = 3, lend = 1, col = INK)
    text((xa + xb) / 2, yb - 0.18, bk[[3]], cex = 0.85, col = INK)
    ya <- y0 + mat_h - (j1 - 1) * cs - 0.04; yz <- y0 + mat_h - j2 * cs + 0.04; xl <- x0 - 0.68
    segments(xl, ya, xl, yz, lwd = 3, lend = 1, col = INK)
    text(xl - 0.12, (ya + yz) / 2, bk[[3]], srt = 90, cex = 0.85, col = INK)
  }
  cb_x <- x_end + 0.12; cb_w <- 0.09
  cb_y <- seq(y0, y0 + mat_h, length.out = length(pal) + 1)
  rect(cb_x, head(cb_y, -1), cb_x + cb_w, tail(cb_y, -1), col = pal, border = NA)
  ticks <- c(-0.6, -0.3, 0, 0.3, 0.6)
  ty <- y0 + (ticks + lim) / (2 * lim) * mat_h
  segments(cb_x + cb_w, ty, cb_x + cb_w + 0.04, ty, col = MUTED)
  text(cb_x + cb_w + 0.07, ty, sprintf("%.1f", ticks), adj = 0, cex = 0.7, col = INK)
  text(cb_x + cb_w + 0.45, y0 + mat_h / 2, "Correlation", srt = 90, cex = 0.8, col = INK)
  text(0.15, pb + H - 0.2, tag, font = 2, cex = 1.4, adj = c(0, 1), col = INK)
}

png(out_corr, width = W, height = Ht, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); plot.new()
draw_corr(R_sum, Z_sum, pb = H, tag = "A")        # top: summary scores
draw_corr(R_sem, Z_sem, pb = 0, tag = "B")        # bottom: model estimates
dev.off()

## ---- Figure 2: hierarchical clustering, A above B -------------------------
draw_hc <- function(R, tag, show_legend = TRUE) {
  hc   <- hclust(as.dist(1 - R), method = "average")
  dend <- reorder(as.dendrogram(hc), wts = seq_len(n), agglo.FUN = mean)   # masking tasks to the left
  leaves <- ord[order.dendrogram(dend)]
  y_lo <- floor((min(hc$height) - 0.05) * 10) / 10
  y_hi <- max(hc$height) + 0.20                                             # headroom for the legend
  par(xpd = FALSE)
  plot(dend, leaflab = "none", ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi), yaxt = "n", edgePar = list(col = INK, lwd = 1.4))
  axis(2, at = seq(y_lo, max(hc$height) + 0.06, by = 0.10), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.75,
       col = MUTED, col.axis = INK, tcl = -0.3)
  mtext("Distance", side = 2, line = 3, cex = 0.85)
  mtext(tag, side = 3, line = -0.2, adj = -0.08, font = 2, cex = 1.2)
  par(xpd = NA)
  points(seq_len(n), rep(y_lo, n), pch = grp_pch[grp[leaves]], cex = 1.3, col = INK)
  text(seq_len(n), y_lo - 0.045 * (y_hi - y_lo) / 0.6, lab[leaves], cex = 0.8, col = INK)
  if (show_legend)
    legend(x = 0.5, y = y_hi, xjust = 0, yjust = 1, legend = grp_name, pch = grp_pch,
           col = INK, bty = "n", cex = 0.8, pt.cex = 1.1)
}

png(out_hc, width = 8, height = 6.4, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(3.2, 4.5, 1.5, 1), yaxs = "i")
draw_hc(R_sum, "A", show_legend = TRUE)           # top: summary scores
draw_hc(R_sem, "B", show_legend = FALSE)          # bottom: model estimates
dev.off()
